introduction: CAPK WIC offers food benefits, nutrition education and breastfeeding support at local clinics. Certification determines participation.
description: CAPK WIC offers food benefits, nutrition education and breastfeeding support at local clinics. Certification determines participation.

sections.who: Eligible categories include pregnancy, recent postpartum periods, breastfeeding, infants and children under five. Ask staff to review income and other certification conditions.
sections.get: The assigned food package depends on participant needs and age. Services are provided at no cost.
sections.docs:
• Ask the clinic for identity, income and residence evidence.
  • Child or pregnancy details needed for assessment.
sections.apply:
1. Request enrollment

    Call 866-327-3074, text888-826-9867 or use CAPK enrollment.

  2. Arrange certification

    Confirm the clinic, appointment and records.

  3. Learn card use

    Staff explain assigned foods and follow-up appointments.
sections.after: Check benefit periods and keep clinic appointments. The request form starts contact; it does not itself decide eligibility.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using CAPK WIC; Enrollment contact. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.
